newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Major to visit Bangladesh in January.
newsitem.headline: Major to visit Bangladesh in January.

text.p: British Prime Minister John Major will make a three-day visit to Bangladesh next month that officials here said would open a new horizon in bilateral relations between the two countries.
The official BSS news agency said on Thursday that Major would arrive on January 10 and meet with Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina and other political leaders.
"The visit has a special significance since this will be the first meeting between the two leaders," BSS quoted an official statement as saying.
Major will be the first British prime minister to visit Bangladesh since James Callaghan in 1978.

The statement said relations between the two countries had been "excellent" and that Britain, the second biggest export market after the United States, remained a potential source of foreign investment in Bangladesh.
Bangladesh exported goods worth 128 million pounds sterling, mostly apparel, to Britain in the first half of 1996 and imported 33.5 million pounds in goods from Britain.

More than 45 British companies have investments in Bangladesh. Britain's Cairns Energy Plc is engaged in gas exploration in the Bay of Bengal and Midland Power International has signed a memorandum of understanding for investment in private power generation projects here.
Major will be accompanied by his wife Norma.
